focus: maintainability — runtime-state exemption ownership, documentation, and OpenCode configuration

findingDetails.title: AC-003 is marked Met despite evidence failing its literal smoke requirement
findingDetails.evidence: REQ-003 requires the plain Pi command to exit 0 and the OpenCode import to print ok. AC-003 records the plain Pi command rc=1 and import output function, yet marks the criterion Met.
findingDetails.recommendation: Rerun the required commands and record matching results, or revise the requirement and acceptance criterion through the packet change process before treating AC-003 as Met.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Direct comparison of 002-pi-opencode-adapters/spec.md:120 with acceptance-criteria.md:41 shows the literal requirement, contradictory observed outcomes, and Met status.

findingDetails.title: Phase 002 closure summary and acceptance record disagree about AC-006
findingDetails.evidence: Acceptance criteria marks AC-006 Met, says Closeable Yes, and reports strict validation passed; implementation-summary says AC-006 is Unmet and packet validation returned RESULT: FAILED, with other rows still pending.
findingDetails.recommendation: Reconcile the implementation summary and acceptance record against final validation evidence, keeping prior failed runs only as dated history.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Direct comparison of acceptance-criteria.md:44,65-67 with implementation-summary.md:102-103,135-145 shows incompatible closure states.

findingDetails.title: Parent phase contract still describes six phases after Phase 007 was added
findingDetails.evidence: The parent phase map lists seven complete children, while handoff and purpose text still says six, scope and file summaries stop at Phase 006, and the 006-to-007 handoff remains TBD; Phase 006 and 007 metadata say 6 of 6 and 7 of 7.
findingDetails.recommendation: Update the parent phase count, scope and file summaries, and 006-to-007 handoff criteria; reconcile the Phase 006 count if it is intended to describe the current sequence.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Cross-document comparison of parent spec.md:39,51,62-86,98-122 with 006/spec.md:27 and 007/spec.md:27 confirms the phase-count and transition mismatch.

results.summary: Parent phase count and 006-to-007 handoff contract do not match the seven completed child rows.
AC-003 outcomes do not satisfy the literal smoke requirement, and AC-006 has conflicting final states.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: The target spans a shared policy core, runtime tests, repository guidance, plugin configuration, and benchmark links.

targetSelection.selectionReason: These files own the state-path policy, its regression boundary, its human guidance, and the model/evidence references.
omittedHighRiskTargets: Runtime and validator execution are deferred; iteration 005 will reconcile recorded evidence and current packet status.

searchLedger.invariant: The runtime-state boundary should have one implementation owner with tests for its edge conditions.

searchActions.result: One root constant feeds the exemption and the regression tests cover the path and README boundary.

searchLedger.rationale: Policy ownership is centralized and boundary cases are explicit in tests.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: No second exemption implementation or untested state-root condition was found in the reviewed files.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Framework guidance may diverge from the implementation or its runtime README.

searchActions.result: Both guidance clauses and the README describe the gitignored state path exemption and concern README boundary consistently with code.

searchLedger.rationale: The same exception and boundary appear in the policy core and user-facing guidance.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: No conflicting state-path wording was found across the reviewed surfaces.

searchLedger.invariant: The default and named agent models should satisfy the phase requirement.

searchActions.result: Default, build, and plan all use llmgateway/deepseek-v4.1-flash; build and plan both use max.

searchLedger.rationale: All three model settings agree with the phase requirement.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: No model or variant mismatch was found.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Run 10 pointers may direct maintainers to different or stale evidence locations.

searchActions.queryOrPath: Search session-relaunch-gate-exemptions references in benchmark index and three playbooks.
searchActions.result: The index and all three playbooks point to the same benchmark run folder.

searchLedger.rationale: The run record has a single indexed location shared by the tested playbooks.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: No stale or inconsistent run 10 pointer was found.
